openai.longDescription: Use PlayDrop to create, upload, publish and manage web games with an optional SDK for advanced features and online services.
capabilities: Add advanced features with the PlayDrop SDK
starterPrompts: Upload and publish this game to PlayDrop and return the URL to play it or any required fixes.

positiveTests.prompt: Plan a small 2D endless runner for PlayDrop with one-button controls.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Activate create-game, define a focused playable scope, choose Phaser, and prepare implementation.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: A concise game plan followed by a runnable project containing the core loop, one-button input, and validation results.
positiveTests.fixture: An empty writable directory. No PlayDrop account is required until upload or publication.

positiveTests.prompt: Update my existing PlayDrop puzzle game so touch controls are easier to use.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Activate update-game, inspect the project, preserve unrelated behavior, implement the control change, and validate it.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: A summary of the diagnosed touch issue, targeted source changes, and passing relevant validation or test results.
positiveTests.fixture: A writable copy of a small PlayDrop puzzle project with working desktop controls and deliberately undersized touch targets.

positiveTests.prompt: Create a consistent transparent 2D pack with a hero, three enemies, and pickups.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Activate make-2d-asset-pack, preserve source inputs, produce transparent PNGs, and run the publication-rights and image checks.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: A validated asset-pack directory with named PNG assets, preview or contact-sheet evidence, and a short rights and validation report.
positiveTests.fixture: An empty writable directory and either user-owned reference art or an explicit request to generate original art.

positiveTests.prompt: Playtest this PlayDrop game before I publish it.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Activate playtest-game, run supported smoke and visual checks, inspect active gameplay evidence, and fix or report concrete player-facing issues.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: A prioritized playtest report with reproduction evidence, changes made when authorized, and final validation status.
positiveTests.fixture: A runnable local PlayDrop game fixture with at least one known input or first-run usability issue.

positiveTests.prompt: Prepare the listing for my finished PlayDrop game.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Activate make-listing, inspect the finished game, create accurate metadata and truthful media, and validate the catalogue.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: A complete listing manifest plus the required media files and a passing catalogue validation result.
positiveTests.fixture: A runnable finished PlayDrop game with permission to capture its gameplay and a writable project directory. Authentication is required only if the reviewer asks the agent to upload it.

negativeTests.prompt: Review my employee performance notes and recommend promotions.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Do not activate a PlayDrop skill; handle the request using another appropriate capability or explain that the plugin is unrelated.
negativeTests.rationale: Employment review is outside browser-game creation and PlayDrop creator workflows.

negativeTests.prompt: Configure Terraform for my AWS production network.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Do not activate a PlayDrop skill; use infrastructure-specific guidance if available.
negativeTests.rationale: General cloud infrastructure work is outside the plugin's purpose.

negativeTests.prompt: Write a native iOS budgeting app in SwiftUI.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Do not activate a PlayDrop skill; use native iOS development guidance if available.
negativeTests.rationale: The requested product is not a PlayDrop browser game.

openai.releaseNotes: Ships the portable Agent Plugins 1.0 package with first-class Tweaks for in-game tuning, Playtest Notes for precise agent feedback, and public creator and agent documentation for both workflows.

cursor.description: Create, upload, publish and manage web games on PlayDrop.
